meta.title: WP Commerce Toolkit
meta.description: A full-featured e-commerce toolkit for WordPress — products, carts, checkout, and payment gateway integrations.

reference.name: wp-commerce-toolkit
reference.description: A full-featured e-commerce toolkit for WordPress.

functions.name: wct_get_product
functions.description: Retrieve a product by ID or slug. Returns a WCT_Product instance or null if not found.

params.name: $args
params.description: Optional query arguments. Supports 'include_meta' and 'cache' keys.

functions.name: wct_add_to_cart
functions.description: Add a product to the current session cart. Fires the 'wct_cart_item_added' action on success.

returns.description: Cart item key on success, false on failure.

functions.name: wct_get_cart
functions.description: Get the current cart instance for the active session.

functions.name: wct_format_price
functions.description: Format a numeric price value according to the store's currency settings.

params.name: $currency
params.description: Currency code (e.g. 'USD'). Defaults to store currency.

functions.name: wct_create_order
functions.description: Create a new order from the current cart contents and customer data.

returns.description: Order object on success, WP_Error on failure.

functions.name: wct_register_payment_gateway
functions.description: Register a custom payment gateway class with the checkout system.

functions.name: wct_get_template
functions.description: Load a template file from the plugin's templates directory, with theme override support.

params.name: $template_name
params.description: Template file name relative to templates/ dir.

params.name: $args
params.description: Variables to extract into template scope.

functions.name: wct_get_currency_symbol
functions.description: Get the symbol for a given currency code.

functions.name: wct_get_cart_total
functions.description: Calculate and return the current cart total including tax and discounts.

functions.name: wct_apply_coupon
functions.description: Apply a coupon code to the current cart.

returns.description: True on success, WP_Error on failure.

functions.name: wct_is_purchasable
functions.description: Check whether a product can be purchased (in stock, published, price > 0).

classes.name: WCT_Product
classes.description: Core product data model. Represents a single product with pricing, inventory, and metadata.

methods.name: get_id
methods.description: Get the product ID.

methods.name: get_name
methods.description: Get the product name.

methods.name: get_price
methods.description: Get the product price.

methods.name: get_sale_price
methods.description: Get the sale price if set.

methods.name: is_on_sale
methods.description: Check whether the product is currently on sale.

methods.name: is_in_stock
methods.description: Check stock availability.

methods.name: get_stock_quantity
methods.description: Get available stock count.

classes.name: WCT_Cart
classes.description: Shopping cart manager. Handles session-based cart storage, item management, and total calculations.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Get the cart singleton instance.

methods.name: add_item
methods.description: Add a product to the cart.

methods.name: remove_item
methods.description: Remove an item by its cart key.

methods.name: get_total
methods.description: Calculate the cart total with tax and discounts.

methods.name: get_subtotal
methods.description: Get pre-tax, pre-discount subtotal.

methods.name: empty_cart
methods.description: Remove all items from the cart.

classes.name: WCT_Order
classes.description: Order data model. Wraps a WP post of type 'wct_order' with commerce-specific accessors.

methods.name: get_id
methods.description: Get the order ID.

methods.name: get_status
methods.description: Get the order status.

methods.name: get_total
methods.description: Get the order total.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Get line items for this order.

methods.name: update_status
methods.description: Transition the order to a new status.

classes.name: WCT_Payment_Gateway
classes.description: Abstract base class for payment gateway integrations. Extend this to add new payment methods.

methods.name: get_id
methods.description: Return the gateway identifier slug.

methods.name: get_title
methods.description: Return the human-readable gateway title.

methods.name: process_payment
methods.description: Process a payment for the given order. Must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: process_refund
methods.description: Process a refund for an order.

classes.name: WCT_REST_Controller
classes.description: Base REST API controller providing shared utilities for all WCT endpoints.

methods.name: register_routes
methods.description: Register REST routes. Subclasses must implement.

methods.name: get_item_schema
methods.description: Get the JSON schema for a single resource.

methods.name: check_permissions
methods.description: Shared capability check for write operations.

actions.name: wct_cart_item_added
actions.description: Fires after a product is successfully added to the cart.

actions.name: wct_cart_emptied
actions.description: Fires after the cart is completely emptied.

actions.name: wct_order_status_changed
actions.description: Fires when an order transitions to a new status.

actions.name: wct_after_checkout
actions.description: Fires after checkout is complete and the order is created.

actions.name: wct_payment_complete
actions.description: Fires after a payment gateway returns success.

actions.name: wct_init
actions.description: Fires when the WCT plugin has fully initialized. Safe to register gateways and extend.

actions.name: wct_send_order_email
actions.description: Sends order confirmation email to the customer.

actions.name: wct_update_stock
actions.description: Reduces stock quantities when an order is placed.

actions.name: wct_clear_cart_after_order
actions.description: Empties the cart after a successful order.

filters.name: wct_product_price
filters.description: Filters the final display price of a product.

filters.name: wct_cart_item_data
filters.description: Filters the data stored for a cart item before it's added.

filters.name: wct_order_statuses
filters.description: Filters the list of available order statuses.

filters.name: wct_currency_symbol
filters.description: Filters the currency symbol for a given currency code.

filters.name: wct_available_gateways
filters.description: Filters the list of available payment gateways at checkout.

filters.name: wct_format_price_html
filters.description: Filters the final HTML output of a formatted price.

filters.name: wct_checkout_fields
filters.description: Filters the checkout form field configuration.

filters.name: wct_tax_rate
filters.description: Adjusts the tax rate based on customer location.

cssTokens.name: --wct-color-primary
cssTokens.description: Primary brand color used for buttons and links.

cssTokens.name: --wct-font-mono
cssTokens.description: Monospace font for code and prices.

cssTokens.name: --wct-checkout-accent
cssTokens.description: Accent color for checkout form focus states.

notes: Added coupon system with percentage and fixed-amount discounts.
New `wct_apply_coupon()` function and coupon management UI.
Improved checkout field validation with inline error messages.
Added REST API endpoints for products and orders.
New `WCT_REST_Controller` base class for API extensions.
Improved cart session handling for logged-out users.
Major refactor of the order system — orders are now a custom post type.
Deprecated `wct_get_cart_total()` in favor of `WCT_Cart::get_total()`.
Added stock management and low-stock notifications.
New tax calculation system with location-based rates.
Added refund support via `process_refund()` on payment gateways.
New `wct_checkout_fields` filter for customizing checkout forms.
Performance improvements to cart total calculations.
Introduced the payment gateway API — extend `WCT_Payment_Gateway` to add custom methods.
Added `wct_register_payment_gateway()` and `wct_available_gateways` filter.
Stock quantity tracking on products.
New order system with `WCT_Order` class.
Checkout flow with `wct_before_checkout` and `wct_after_checkout` actions.
Sale price support on products.
Initial release.
Product management, cart system, basic checkout.
Template system with theme override support.
Currency formatting utilities.
